[DQC.US.0249.10961] The filing has reported a value for the element us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness with a value of 12,400,000 using the axis IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis in the role 9955553 - Disclosure - Income Taxes - Narrative (Details) on the table us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwardsTable. However, the only member used to disaggregate the total for us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness was the member ttek:NorwayOperationsMember. If only one member is used on this axis then the filer should either:
1. Retag the filing using the element DiscontinuedOperationNameExtensibleEnumeration or DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationNameExtensibleEnumeration with a value of ttek:NorwayOperationsMember. The member ttek:NorwayOperationsMember should be removed from the value as it represents the aggregate value of 12,400,000.
2. Tag the aggregate value of us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness with a value of 12,400,000 without the IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis axis. This rule will not generate an error if the aggregate value of us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness is reported.
The properties of this us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness fact are: Period :2025-09-29 to 2025-12-28 Dimensions : us-gaap:IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis=ttek:NorwayOperationsMember, us-gaap:DisposalGroupClassificationAxis=us-gaap:DisposalGroupDisposedOfBySaleNotDiscontinuedOperationsMember Unit : USD
